definitions.explanation: Describes something of the smallest possible size, degree, or amount. Used both as a noun and as a modifier with の.

examples.japanese: {極小|きょくしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An extremely small camera was developed.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{極小|きょくしょう}⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{肉眼|にくがん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}え→見える：01165_mieru⟧にくい。
examples.english: This component is so tiny that it's hard to see with the naked eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極小|きょくしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じた→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧。
examples.english: We took measures to keep the damage to an absolute minimum.

notes:
Can function as a noun meaning "the very smallest" or as a modifier ({極小|きょくしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧) meaning "extremely small, minute." In mathematics, {極小|きょくしょう} refers to a local minimum (as opposed to ⟦{極大|きょくだい}→極大：20767_kyokudai⟧, local maximum).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {極小|きょくしょう}⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧ — extremely small size
- {極小|きょくしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{粒子|りゅうし}→粒子：14970_ryuushi⟧ — minute particles
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極小|きょくしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to minimize damage
- {極小|きょくしょう}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧ — micro-house; tiny dwelling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{微小|びしょう}→微小：20095_bishou⟧ — very small, minute (more technical/scientific)
- ⟦{最小|さいしょう}→最小：04828_saishou⟧ — smallest, minimum (superlative; the absolute least)
- {極|ごく}{小|しょう}さい — an emphatic phrasing meaning "extremely tiny"

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading きょくしょう is the standard on'yomi compound. The alternative reading {極小|ごくしょう} also exists and is sometimes used interchangeably, though きょくしょう is more common in formal and technical contexts.
